meta_data.base_class: Provide the weather forecast for <country> - referring to a country

tool_template.name: weather_forecast_for_<class>
tool_template.description: Provides weather forecast for a location in <class> based on date.

location.description: The location within the <class> for which to obtain the weather forecast.

date.description: The date for the weather forecast in YYYY-MM-DD format.

units.description: The unit system to use for displaying the weather. Possible values are 'metric', 'imperial', or 'standard'.

include_hourly.description: Boolean flag indicating whether to include an hourly breakdown in the weather forecast for the <country>.

include_historical_data.description: Boolean flag indicating whether to include historical weather data up to the given date for the <country>.

forecast_duration.description: Number of days for which the weather forecast should be provided from the given date for the <country>.

language.description: Language code in which the weather forecast should be provided, to accommodate for localization across different <country>.
